entries.en: to bark (of a dog)
entries.notes: M 栏声调标记污损难辨(T99),R 栏原件空白;词义据 L『Ladrar』与 H『吠』互证明确,声调存疑不影响词义。

entries.en: bark; sound of a dog barking
entries.notes: M 首字声调标记污损(T99);词义据 L『Ladrar』与 H『吠聲』互证明确。

entries.en: (dog) to bark loudly; to howl
entries.notes: L 栏西语残缺(『[残] lepgar』不可复原);词义依 H『狗吼』与 M 栏两降调音写定夺。

entries.en: (dog) to bark; to bark insistently
entries.notes: L 词形 apriera/apriesa 存疑且 M 第二字声调污损(T99);词义据 H『狗吠』明确。

entries.en: brick
entries.notes: M 声调标记污损(T99);词义据 L『Ladrillo』与 H『磚』互证明确,为马尼拉建材语境常词。

entries.en: glazed (smooth-faced) brick; glazed tile
entries.notes: M 末字声调污损(T99);『lişo』依 17 世纪拼读推断为 liso(光滑),与 H『油面磚』相合。

entries.en: thief
entries.notes: M 行上小字残损难辨(形似 chiōr),主读 chàt(賊)可辨;词义据 L『Ladron』与 H『賊』明确。

entries.en: thief; robber; to steal
entries.notes: M 为连笔短语且首词 phù 及中段存疑,疑为例句而非单词;词义据 H『盜』与 L『ladron』定夺。

entries.en: bandit; robber; raider
entries.notes: M 声调标记污损(T99),读法欠确;词义据 L『ladron』与 H『寇』互证。

entries.en: to steal; theft; thief
entries.notes: M 后段连笔串 acconcitay/acconciday 存疑,未能复原其句义;核心词义据 H『竊』与 L『ladron』明确。

entries.en: theft; larceny; to steal
entries.notes: M 中段连笔存疑(phū/iōng);词义据 H『竊盜』与 L『ladron』明确。

entries.en: to steal; to take by stealth
entries.notes: M 末段连笔存疑(iōng/iū̃);词义据 H『竊取』与 L『ladron』明确。

entries.en: soldier (Sp. headword 'ladron soldado': soldier as looter)
entries.notes: L 作『ladron soldado』(贼兵),编译者讥士兵为盗;H/M 仅录『兵』,词义明确,故虽互证而附此说明。

entries.en: to be a thief; to steal

entries.zh: 〔存疑〕疑为『十一人』;置于 ladrón 条下的具体词义未能定夺
entries.en: uncertain: probably 'eleven men'; sense under 'ladrón' unresolved
entries.notes: H 两读存疑(什疾人/十一人),M 音写似『十/廿一+人』数词短语,与 ladrón 语义衔接不明,故按语义无法定夺降 low。

entries.en: to be robbed; to suffer plunder/raid
entries.notes: M 后字连笔存疑(quiap);词义据 H『遭劫』明确。

entries.zh: 叛国之贼;贼寇扰攘作乱(H『賊馬擾攘』词形存疑)
entries.en: thief, traitor to the kingdom; bandits stirring up disorder
entries.notes: L/H/M 三栏均有[疑](Reyno/Reyna、字形、bē/bè),词义以 L『ladron traidor al Reyno』为主轴,汉语侧词形未定。

entries.zh: 贼骸(疑指贼的尸骨);释义存疑
entries.en: 'thief's bones/corpse' (probable; Spanish headword too damaged to reconstruct)
entries.notes: L 栏两处[残]、『der bras』不可复原,M hāy/hay 声调存疑(骸/海未定);姑从 H『賊骸』释为贼之骸骨。

entries.en: form/appearance of a thief (Sp. headword: 'thief of the same sort')
entries.notes: L 作『de la misma suerte』与 H『賊形』义近而不密合,zh 从 H『賊形』;四栏主体清晰,故附此说明。

entries.en: looks/appearance of a thief (Sp. headword: 'thief of the same sort')
entries.notes: M 行尾小字残损(形似 siẽ),主体 chāt siāng 可辨;词义据 H『賊相』与 L『Ladron dela misma suerte』明确。
